steps.title: Prepare Terrific broth
steps.instruction: Combine 3.6 g tryptone, 7.2 g yeast extract and 1.2 mL glycerol in a glass flask, add water to 270 mL, autoclave; separately dissolve 0.231 g KH₂PO₄ (0.017 M) and 1.254 g K₂HPO₄ (0.072 M) in 30 mL water, filter through a 0.45 µm filter, add to autoclaved broth and bring total volume to 300 mL.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Freshly mix per 40 mL (use two 50 mL tubes): 400 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (final 10 mM), 1.2 mL 5 M NaCl (final 150 mM), 400 µL Triton X‑100 (final 1 %), 200 µL 1 M DTT (final 5 mM), 40 mg lysozyme (1 mg/mL), and protease inhibitor cocktail; bring to 40 mL with distilled water, keep on ice and avoid EDTA.

steps.title: Prepare glutathione beads wash buffer
steps.instruction: Freshly mix per 40 mL (two tubes): 400 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (10 mM), 1.2 mL 5 M NaCl (150 mM), 400 µL Triton X‑100 (1 %), 200 µL 1 M DTT (5 mM), bring to 40 mL with water, add protease/phosphatase inhibitor before use, keep on ice; avoid EDTA.

steps.title: Prepare GST elution buffer
steps.instruction: In a 200 mL glass bottle mix 2 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (10 mM), 6 mL 5 M NaCl (150 mM), 2 mL Triton X‑100 (1 %), 1 mL 1 M DTT (5 mM), and 3.07 g reduced glutathione (50 mM); bring to 200 mL with water, adjust pH to 7.2 with 10 N NaOH, store at 4 °C, add protease/phosphatase inhibitor just before use.

steps.title: Prepare Lenti‑X 293T culture medium
steps.instruction: Remove 55 mL from a DMEM bottle, add 50 mL fetal bovine serum (10 % final) and 5 mL penicillin/streptomycin (1 % final) to reach 500 mL total; mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare cell lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Freshly mix per 10 mL: 100 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (10 mM), 300 µL 5 M NaCl (150 mM), 100 µL Triton X‑100 (1 %), 50 µL 1 M DTT (5 mM), add protease/phosphatase inhibitor, then add 20 µg GST‑GINIP (for Gi assay) or 20 µg GST‑GRK2 N‑terminal domain (for Gq assay); bring to 10 mL with water, keep on ice, avoid EDTA.

steps.title: Prepare 2× SDS sample buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 3 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 6.8 (0.12 M final), 5 mL glycerol (20 % final), 10 mL 10 % SDS (4 % final), 2 mL β‑mercaptoethanol (2.5 M final), 2 mL water‑saturated bromophenol blue, and water to 25 mL total; store on ice.

steps.title: Optional: Purify fibronectin from plasma
steps.instruction: Prepare a gelatin Sepharose 4B column (25 mL resin), wash sequentially with 16 column volumes of cleaning buffer #1 (20 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.5, 20 mL 5 M NaCl, water to 200 mL) and cleaning buffer #2 (20 mL 100 mM sodium acetate, 20 mL 5 M NaCl, adjust to pH 4.5 with acetic acid, water to 200 mL). Thaw frozen bovine plasma, add 1 mM PMSF, centrifuge at 20 000 × g, load supernatant onto column, wash with 12 column volumes of column wash buffer #1 (PBS 1×, 1 mM PMSF, 2 mM EDTA), then 4 volumes of wash buffer #2 (PBS 1×, 1 mM PMSF, 58.44 g NaCl), then 2 volumes of wash buffer #1 again. Elute fibronectin with 50 mL elution buffer (dialysis buffer 1×, 4 M urea, 24 g urea). Collect 1.5 mL fractions, measure A₂₈₀, pool fractions starting at A₂₈₀ 0.7, dialyze overnight at 4 °C in dialysis buffer (10 mM CAPS, 0.15 M NaCl, 1 mM PMSF, 2 mM EDTA, adjust to pH 11 with 10 N NaOH, water to 4 L), change buffer next morning and incubate 3 h more. Adjust final concentration to 1 mg/mL (A₂₈₀ 1.3 = 1 mg/mL), aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid N₂ and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Amplify GST‑bait plasmids in Stbl3 (optional)
steps.instruction: Transform One‑Shot™ Stbl3™ chemically competent E. coli with GST‑GINIP or GST‑GRK2 N‑terminal domain plasmids, plate on LB agar + 100 µg/mL ampicillin, pick a single colony, inoculate LB broth + 100 µg/mL ampicillin, grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking, isolate plasmid using a standard miniprep kit.

steps.title: Transform BL21(DE3) with GST‑bait plasmid
steps.instruction: Transform BL21(DE3) competent cells with the GST‑bait plasmid (GINIP or GRK2 N‑terminal domain) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Express GST‑bait protein in Terrific broth
steps.instruction: Inoculate transformed BL21(DE3) into several 3 mL Terrific broth tubes containing 100 µg/mL ampicillin; incubate overnight at 37 °C with shaking. Add 100 µg/mL ampicillin to 300 mL Terrific broth (prepared as above), inoculate with 10 mL overnight preculture, grow at 37 °C for 3 h, add IPTG stock (1 M, stored at –20 °C) to a final concentration of 100 µM, then incubate at 30 °C for 5 h with vigorous shaking.

steps.title: Harvest and freeze bacterial pellets
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cultures at 6 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, immediately freeze pellets in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (optional for later use).

steps.title: Lyse bacteria and clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in bacterial lysis buffer on ice (10 mL buffer per 50 mL culture), incubate on ice 15 min, sonicate on ice (3 × 30 s bursts at 50 % duty cycle, 50 % output, 30 s cooling intervals), then centrifuge lysate at 20 000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bind GST‑bait to glutathione beads
steps.instruction: While lysate is centrifuging, wash 2 mL glutathione Sepharose 4B beads with 40 mL glutathione beads wash buffer for equilibration. Add cleared supernatant to the equilibrated beads, rotate at 4 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Wash and elute GST‑bait protein
steps.instruction: Centrifuge bead mixture at 500 × g for 30 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend beads in 40 mL glutathione beads wash buffer, centrifuge again; repeat wash total of four times. Elute bound protein with 3 mL GST elution buffer, rotate overnight at 4 °C, then centrifuge at 500 × g for 30 min at 4 °C and collect supernatant.

steps.title: Desalt, quantify, aliquot, and store GST‑bait
steps.instruction: Desalt eluate on Zeba™ spin desalting columns (7 kDa MWCO, 10 mL) to remove glutathione and exchange buffer, measure protein concentration with Bio‑Rad Protein Assay Dye Reagent, aliquot into 20 µg portions, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C; thaw aliquots immediately before use.

steps.title: Package lentivirus in Lenti‑X 293T cells
steps.instruction: Maintain Lenti‑X 293T cells in Lenti‑X 293T medium at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. When cells reach 70‑80 % confluence in a 100 mm dish (antibiotic‑free DMEM + 10 % FBS), transfect with 5 µg GluGlu‑tagged Gα (or Gq + Ric8A) vector, 5 µg psPAX2, and 5 µg pMD2.G in 500 µL Opti‑MEM; add 25 µL Lipofectamine 2000 pre‑diluted in 500 µL Opti‑MEM, incubate 20 min, add to cells, incubate 2 h, then replace with 10 mL HUVEC medium lacking penicillin/streptomycin. Incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest, centrifuge, filter, and optionally concentrate lentivirus
steps.instruction: Collect supernatant, centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min to remove cells, filter through a 0.45 µm filter; optionally concentrate by ultracentrifugation or PEG‑it precipitation according to manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Introduce GluGlu‑tagged Gα into target cells
steps.instruction:
Choose either (a) transfection or (b) lentiviral infection.
(a) Transfection: seed target cells (e.g., HUVECs or other) to 50‑80 % confluence in a 100 mm dish with antibiotic‑free medium, prepare 5 µg GluGlu‑Gα (or Gq + Ric8A) plasmid in 500 µL Opti‑MEM, add 25 µL Lipofectamine 2000 in 500 µL Opti‑MEM, incubate 20 min, add to cells, incubate 2 h, then replace with appropriate antibiotic‑free medium and culture 24‑48 h.
(b) Infection: add appropriate volume of lentivirus to cells in optimal medium (e.g., HUVECs), optionally supplement with 8 µg/mL polybrene, incubate 24 h, replace medium, and culture until expression is confirmed.

steps.title: Prepare protein samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Lyse transfected/infected cells with cell lysis buffer (prepared in step 6), solubilize proteins, keep on ice, then load 8 µL of each sample (pulldown and total lysate) onto a 10 % acrylamide SDS‑PAGE gel (optimal for Gα proteins).

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer to nitrocellulose
steps.instruction: Run the gel using standard electrophoresis conditions, then transfer proteins onto a nitrocellulose membrane (e.g., Bio‑Rad 10484059) using a wet or semi‑dry transfer system.

steps.title: Block membrane and probe with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Block membrane in 5 % non‑fat dry milk (Omniblok) for 1 h at room temperature, then incubate overnight at 4 °C with anti‑GluGlu monoclonal antibody (1:1,000) in blocking buffer with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Wash and incubate with HRP secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times with 1× TBS‑T (0.1 % Tween‑20), then incubate 1 h at room temperature with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody (appropriate dilution) while shaking, followed by four washes with 1× TBS‑T.

steps.title: Detect signals with ECL
steps.instruction: Apply enhanced chemiluminescence (ECL) substrate to the membrane and capture chemiluminescent signal using a CCD camera or film to visualize GluGlu‑tagged Gα pulldown bands.

steps.title: Strip membrane and re‑probe with GST and loading controls
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane with Reblot Plus Strong stripping solution (10×) for 15 min, wash twice with TBS‑T, cut membrane between pulldown and lysate lanes, then re‑probe pulldown lanes with GST antibody (1:1,000) and lysate lanes with tubulin antibody (1:10,000) or actin antibody (1:2,000). Develop as before.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol has been used and validated in the following article: • Tanaka et al. [16]. Latrophilin-2 mediates fluid shear stress mechanotransduction at endothelial junctions ( Figures 1 and 2 , Appendix Figure S3).
